policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: Iraq arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Iraq's Foreign Ministry expressly includes Swiss passports among nationalities granted a visa on arrival at land, air and sea border crossings.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Swiss passport. The stated border-issued visa is valid for 60 days and requires payment of the stated fee; health and safety entry conditions apply.

Iraq advises the named nationals to apply for an eVisa before travel from 1 March 2025, but that advice does not displace the explicitly stated available arrival-issuance route. Iraqi-origin travellers, residence, work, special passports, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Panama's official embassy immigration guidance names Switzerland among nationalities that do not need a visa for a visitor stay of up to three months.
conditions: Visa-free for the listed ordinary Swiss-national visitor route for up to three months. Carry a passport valid for at least three months, onward travel and proof of funds if requested.
Employment, residence, transit, third-country visa or residence exemptions, special passports and final admission remain separate.
